headline: Public hearings on driveway paving at 141 Woodland Street and rooftop solar panels at 81 Oakland Street.
summary: The driveway hearing continues from October 28, 2026. The solar panel hearing is for applicant Aaron Prestwich of ION Developer, LLC, with owner Linda Romanauskas.
items: Continued public hearing on Application #2026-10-03: driveway paving and expansion at 141 Woodland Street and a new driveway on Oakland Street; Sabrena Lawrence, owner and applicant
Public hearing on Application #2026-11-01: installation of 13 rooftop solar panels at 81 Oakland Street; Aaron Prestwich/ION Developer, LLC, applicant; Linda Romanauskas, owner
location: City Hall, Council Chambers, First Floor, 111 North Main Street
